text.tspan: REQUEST-TO-NEED TRACE
由要求追溯至需要
Clarify the need behind the request before choosing an implementation. 在选择实施方案前，厘清原始要求背后的实际需要
01 CAPTURE THE REQUEST 记录原始要求
Request ID 要求编号
Which statement is being traced?
该要求能追溯到之前的什么问题和编号？
Expressed request 原始要求
What was initially requested?
Source role
02 CLARIFY THE NEED 厘清底层需要
Assumed problem 假设的问题
What problem does the request assume?
Underlying need 底层需要
Success evidence 成功的判断依据
What observable evidence would demonstrate
that need?
03 OPEN THE DESIGN SPACE 拓展设计空间
Candidate implementations 候选方案
What other technical approaches could meet it?
Open assumptions 未验证假设
Which claims remain uncertain?
REQUEST 要求
NEED 需求
EVIDENCE 依据
ALTERNATIVES 替代方案
ASSUMPTIONS 假设
提出者原话是怎么说的
谁在什么情境下提出？他有什么经验和权力？
这项要求假设了什么问题/提出者认为当前的的不足
改写成非技术的需求
什么结果可以证明这项需要得到了满足
(除了当前方案)还有什么技术方案？
